evals.name: register-author
evals.prompt: Implement the Library registration command in its feature file.
evals.expected_output: A model-bound record returning an event.
assertions: Places RegisterAuthor in Features/Authors/Registration/RegisterAuthor.cs and marks it Command.
Selects the event source using a property of type AuthorId deriving from EventSourceId<Guid>, independently of parameter order.

evals.name: one-fact
evals.prompt: RegisterAuthor appends to the event log and returns an event. Correct it and describe the expected write.
evals.expected_output: One event appended by Arc with Chronicle.
assertions: Describes one registration event on the supplied author ID, carrying the submitted name.

evals.name: author-id
evals.prompt: Which AuthorId type should RegisterAuthor reference, and where does it belong?
evals.expected_output: A Guid event-source concept in the author namespace.
assertions: Uses the shared Library.Features.Authors.AuthorId rather than declaring a second type.
Keeps the caller's ID instead of creating one in Handle.
